t: Organiser with seal for protection from water and dust. Robust, clear polycarbonate cover provides impact resistance. Large, heavy duty metal latches keep the lid securely closed and auto-lock side latch enables single handed operation. Stackable and can be easily clicked onto any module of the DEWALT ToughSystem range. Supplied with 8 x small and 2 x large storage cups with flexibility to make smaller cups by adding dividers. Can also be removed for ease of access and fit into the DEWALT Nail Pouch.
